0022600029.text: Memphis hosts Oklahoma City in Emirates NBA Cup West Group B play, with both teams at 6-2 through eight games. The Grizzlies, 2nd in the Southwest and 0.5 games back, have lost their last two, while the Thunder, 2nd in the Northwest, have won two straight. Memphis is 2-2 at home and 4-0 on the road, Oklahoma City is 4-0 at home and 2-2 on the road, and the Grizzlies lost 0-3 to the Thunder in the 2025-26 season series, including a 117-116 loss in Memphis on January 9, 2026; Memphis is without Scotty Pippen Jr. (out, back soreness) and Isaiah Stewart (day-to-day, knee, game-time decision), while Oklahoma City is without Cason Wallace (out, shoulder surgery), Chet Holmgren (out, knee), Jalen Williams (out, leg fracture), Jaylin Williams (out, back spasms), Nikola Topic (out, back), and Thomas Sorber (out, knee).
